data.title: 青山七海 · 练习道的黄浮标
data.description: 七海顺着海滨练习道走到浅水边，把一枚脱离绳子的黄浮标推回原位。她给岸上的同伴比了个手势，确认最后一个标记在一条线上才回头。
data.action: 在齐膝的海水里扶住黄色浮标，抬手示意
data.lighting: 太阳从海面反光，岸边有白色浪线
data.camera: 与人物平视的全身，练习道延向画外
data.promptProse: Nanami stands knee-deep on the outside of a marked swimming lane and guides a yellow float back against its rope. Her navy halterneck swimsuit has a clean white edge. She raises her free hand toward a teammate on the beach while shallow sunlit water ripples around her legs.
data.animaCaption: She holds the yellow float against its line and raises her other hand toward the shore.
